checkpoint_test_decision.basis: The package reports a successful serial real-GPAW full-wavefunction GPW write/readback, a four-rank write-failure synchronization test, and a prior completed synthetic four-rank readback. The production runner collectively stops all MPI ranks on checkpoint write/readback failure, keeps prior verified checkpoints, and does not retry or allow the collector to emit labels from an incomplete run.
checkpoint_test_decision.limitation: One optional four-rank synthetic H initialization repeat did not reach the checkpoint hook before the time limit and is inconclusive; it is not a checkpoint failure and is not counted as a pass.
checkpoint_test_decision.residual_risk: A four-rank success-path checkpoint could still fail during the actual single point; this wastes part of the bounded run but fails closed with no scientific label.

failure_policy.checkpoint_error: Collective safe stop; retain previous verified checkpoint and logs; no retry; collector must not emit energy/force/stress labels
failure_policy.collector_acceptance: Only a complete converged record with matching log marker, status, step count, R2 identity, role, authorization/config/source hashes, finite energy/free energy and correctly shaped finite force/stress arrays may produce SUCCESS
failure_policy.nonconvergence: FAILED_SCF; preserve logs and latest verified checkpoint; no retry; no labels
failure_policy.wall_clock: Orderly stop at 12600 seconds with checkpoint attempt; 14400-second hard deadline; incomplete result is rejected by collector
